browser.limits: Every embedded view was opened once in the first context; controls, each answer, the notes and one modal were exercised in all four contexts. Axe audits are of the closed page only, not native acceptance. Firefox and an open-dialog accessibility audit were not run.

visualInspection: All 128 published views were read in full on eight sheets, one per panel, text size and theme, at about a quarter of their size: no status strip, system dialog, notification or keyboard notice. The typing-inside-a-call views of the three layouts were also read at larger scale for the inner panel. Small text was checked from each view's hierarchy, not by eye.
